notes.title: Sad news
notes.notes:
Hey.

Sad news about HELLPUNK. The game is currently in an indefinite hiatus, due to several different circumstances.

This has been extremely painful for me personally, as it has been my passion project for years, but also since it represented my hopes to professionally run my own game studio.

I really should have made this announcement six months ago, but I’ve had a hard time processing it, and especially writing about it. Sorry for having kept you waiting for so long.

However, in the final months of last year my publisher decided to drop the project due to creative differences. My vision was a more brutal horror focused project, and less of a boomer shooter. This happened very suddenly, and the lack of funding forced me to quickly find a new job to provide for me and my family.

Essentially this forced me to exit the game industry and get a “normal” job, working in app development. The dream for me would be to keep working on HELLPUNK as a personal project, even though the scope would have to be narrowed due to a lack of funding and time.

The problem is that I can’t. It has just been too painful to look at the game, since it represents years of struggle and doubt, and I haven’t been able to work on it since. I want to finish the game, and I know it has a lot of potential. I just can’t find the enthusiasm or motivation anymore. Though it’s not like I’m formally canceling the game; it’s rather put in cryostasis in my metaphorical basement, hoping that I can go down there and face it again some day.

I won’t stop making games however, I don’t even think that I can. I just need to focus on something else, make something that I enjoy, and hopefully find that motivation some day.

Thanks for all the support over the years, it has meant the world to me.

Philip

notes.title: Hell Punk Awakening Announced
notes.notes:
After at lot of deliberation, I've decided to split Hell Punk into two releases, beginning with Hell Punk Awakening. It is a standalone game that also acts as a prologue to Hell Punk Horror.

Find out more at its steam page:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1725630/Hell_Punk_Awakening/

notes.title: Change of release date
notes.notes: 2020 was a pretty hard year, and even though the game is almost finished it needs a few more weeks in development. Most of the content is in place for the initial early access release, however, there are still a few things that needs to be finalized. Thank you for your patience, the wait is almost over!

notes.title: DEMO Update!
notes.notes:
The DEMO has been updated with some smaller fixes and improvements.

Notable changes:

On startup you get to pick a graphics preset to fit your pc and how you want the game to look.

You can now evade in all four directions by pressing the "crouch" key while walking!

Fixed issues with the prism.

Added more info about the saferoom.

Made the objective clearer.

Beyond that I really want to thank everyone who has tried out the demo this far, your support means a lot!

notes.title: Alpha Demo Available Now!
notes.notes:
An alpha version of the first dimension of Hell Punk Horror is available on Windows. This is not representative of the full version and probably has tons of bugs, but that's part of the charm right?

Have fun and let me know what you think of the demo! 😉

This demo will only be available for a limited time.
